name: Extract data from resume and create PDF with Gotenberg
description: This workflow extracts structured data from resumes using AI, converts it into HTML, and then generates a well-formatted PDF using Gotenberg.

inputs.system: Your task is to extract all necessary data such as first name, last name, experience, known technologies etc. from the provided resume text and return in well-unified JSON format. Do not make things up.

source.path: PDF_and_Document_Processing/Extract data from resume and create PDF with Gotenberg.json

hints: The original started from telegramTrigger; Yantra has no webhook slug for it, so run on demand, on a schedule (add a NodeCron), or via the workflow API with the event under the run input `event`.
"Get file" (telegram.file.get): Uses the Telegram Bot API getFile HTTP call with the bot token from a workflow secret; download file_path from the JSON result.
"Get file": the file itself is at https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<file_path>; the token is the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN workflow secret.
"Extract text from PDF" (extractFromFile.pdf): Parsed via googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_PARSE_FILE; the file must live on Google Drive (upload first if the previous step only has bytes/base64).

"Extract text from PDF": GOOGLESUPER_PARSE_FILE needs a Drive file_id (and googlesuper credential). If the upstream step only has file bytes, upload with GOOGLESUPER_CREATE_FILE_FROM_TEXT / Drive upload first, then parse.
"Merge personal info and technologies" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was combine).
"Merge education and employment history" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was combine).
"Merge projects and volunteering" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was combine).
"Merge other data" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was combine).
"Merge all" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was combine).
"Convert to HTML" (convertToFile.toBinary): The file is a `{ data, fileName, mimeType }` object (text, or base64 for toBinary); point the next step at `data`.

"Generate plain PDF doc" (httpRequest.multipart-form-data): the request is a plain-http request (http://gotenberg:3000/forms/chromium/convert/html); yantra-storage HTTP_SEND only reaches public https hosts.

"Send PDF to the user" (message.sendDocument): the file comes from "Generate plain PDF doc" (httpRequest), which is a plain-http request (http://gotenberg:3000/forms/chromium/convert/html); yantra-storage HTTP_SEND only reaches public https hosts; hand the file over as base64 bytes or a public https URL before this step.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

"Parse resume data": normalized the legacy output schema for LLMChain's strict parser (shorthand/examples become JSON Schema; email/date formats use syntax patterns). Review the schema before running.

notes:
### Add chat ID
Remember to set your actual ID to trigger automation from Telegram.

### Ignore start message
Workflow ignores initial`/start` message sent to the bot.

### Download resume file
Based on file ID, node performs downloading of the file uploaded by user.

### Extract text from PDF
Node extracts readable text form PDF.

### Parse resume data
Create structured data from text extracted from resume. Chain uses OpenAI `gpt-4-turbo-preview` model and JSON response mode. **Adjust JSON schema in output parser to your needs.**

### Format HTML
Format HTML for each resume section (employment history, projects etc.).

### Create HTML file
From formatted output create `index.html` file in order to run PDF conversion.

### Convert file to PDF
Form `index.html` create PDF using [Gotenberg](https://gotenberg.dev/). If you're not familiar with this software, feel free to check out [my tutorial on YouTube](https://youtu.be/bo15xdjXf1Y?si=hFZMTfjzfSOLOLPK).

### Send PDF file to user
Deliver converted PDF to Telegram user (based on chat ID).

## ⚠️ Note

This is *resume extractor* workflow that I had a pleasure to present during [n8n community hangout](https://youtu.be/eZacuxrhCuo?si=KkJQrgQuvLxj-6FM&t=1701
) on March 7, 2024.

1. Remember to add your credentials and configure nodes.
2. This node requires installed [Gotenberg](https://gotenberg.dev/) for PDF generation. If you're not familiar with this software, feel free to check out [my tutorial on YouTube](https://youtu.be/bo15xdjXf1Y?si=hFZMTfjzfSOLOLPK). If you don't want to self-host Gotenberg, you use other PDF generation provider (PDFMonkey, ApiTemplate or similar).
3. If you like this workflow, please subscribe to [my YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@workfloows) and/or [my newsletter](https://workfloows.com/).
